assertions.assertion: Reads the KB state (orbit-kb show open) before it acts, not the code alone
assertions.evidence: Before giving any plan, the agent ran `orbit-kb show open`, then `orbit-kb --dir kb show open` once the KB was found, along with `lint` and `whynot 'done'`. The output was "Open: - under c1". It also read kb/kb.pl and kb/runs/1-k1.log.

assertions.assertion: Reports claim c1 as under, with its red check k1
assertions.evidence: The agent said "`show open` reports one open item: `under c1`" and "Check `k1` is that test". It also said "The red run is recorded in `kb/runs/1-k1.log`: `6.0 != 6.21371`".

assertions.assertion: Mentions the dormant question q1 and its default, or leaves it dormant on purpose
assertions.evidence: The agent wrote: "Decide open question `q1`: 'Round the result, or return the full float?' The KB currently assumes `full_float`. That's my default, not your answer." It plans to list the default as a guess in the delivery report.
Every tool call was a read-only command (ls, find, cat, orbit-kb show/lint/whynot). The agent said "I only ran read-only queries and didn't change any code."
